verifications.claim: Venezuela has been crowned 2026 World Baseball Classic Champions
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Venezuela ganó la final del Clásico Mundial de Béisbol de 2026 ante Estados Unidos en Miami y se coronó campeón'; R2: 'Venezuela breaking through against Team USA... The title is Venezuela’s first'; R3: 'Venezuela has won the World Baseball Classic for the first time... 2026: VENEZUELA'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state Venezuela won the 2026 WBC championship.

verifications.claim: Venezuela defeated the United States 3-2 in the final in Miami
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Venezuela venció a Estados Unidos por 3 a 2... en Miami'; R2: 'The Venezuelans defeated the United States 3-2 on Tuesday in Miami'; R3: 'upsetting a star-studded United States team 3-2 in the championship game in Miami'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly confirm the 3-2 defeat of USA by Venezuela in the Miami final.

verifications.claim: Daniel Palencia secured the final out for Venezuela
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '¡Palencia sacó también a Anthony'; R2: 'Venezuela closer Daniel Palencia’s fastball reached the glove of Salvador Perez for the final out'; R3: 'Daniel Palencia closed out the game'
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm Palencia got the final out.

verifications.claim: Venezuela finished a perfect tournament run
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Venezuela had to face all three in this tournament, losing to the D.R. in pool play before recovering'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly contradicts by stating Venezuela lost to Dominican Republic in pool play; no sources claim a perfect (undefeated) run.

verifications.claim: The final score was Venezuela 3, USA 2
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Venezuela venció a Estados Unidos por 3 a 2'; R2: 'defeated the United States 3-2'; R3: '3-2'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state the final score as Venezuela 3, USA 2.

verifications.claim: This is Venezuela's first-ever World Baseball Classic title
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'se coronó campeón por primera vez'; R2: 'The title is Venezuela’s first in six incarnations of the WBC'; R3: 'Venezuela won its first WBC title... for the first time'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state it is Venezuela's first WBC title.

verifications.claim: The victory was secured in the 9th inning
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'carreras en la tercera, quinta y novena entrada'; R2: 'Suárez struck [in ninth]... Palencia got through the bottom of the ninth'; R3: 'retoke the lead in the top of the ninth... Palencia closed out the game'
verifications.reasoning: All references describe Venezuela scoring the go-ahead run and closing out the game in the 9th inning.
